_comment: Hand-maintained. Zephyr's git history does not mark LTS releases or contract-breaking boundaries, so findings derived from this file carry the 'hops.release-data' heuristic. Sources: docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/releases/index.html (supported releases and the release cadence table), checked 2026-10-27.

3.7.title: Hardware Model v2
3.7.detail: Board names gain SoC/variant qualifiers (e.g. native_sim_64 -> native_sim/native/64); boards/deprecated.cmake maps old names, and board directories and Kconfig were restructured.
